author: marthomahew
name: avatar
short: Get someone's profile pictures at full size.
description: `[p]avatar @user`, `/avatar` or right-click a user → Apps → Get avatar: posts their avatar, server avatar and banner at original size (PNG, or GIF if animated).
install_msg: Loaded? As bot owner: `[p]slash enable avatar`, `[p]slash enable "Get avatar" user`, then `[p]slash sync`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data.
